本版加了网页助手与会话级无障碍：打开英文页或长文页会先问你一句，选中文字可以直接问 AI，读屏开启时弹窗改走系统确认框。

This release adds page-level assistance and screen-reader support: English or long pages ask before acting, selected text can be sent straight to the AI, and prompts fall back to system dialogs when a screen reader is on.

- 检测到英文页面会先问「要不要翻译」，不再悄悄跳转翻译页
- English pages now ask before translating instead of silently redirecting.
- 正文较长的页面会问「要不要总结」，一键打开 AI 总结
- Long pages offer a one-tap AI summary.
- 菜单新增「选中问 AI」：长按选中文字即可问「这是什么？」
- New "Ask AI about selection" action: select text on a page and ask what it is.
- AI 对话新增常用问法一键填入（这是什么 / 这篇讲什么 / 总结要点 / 翻译这段）
- Quick-fill questions added to AI chat.
- 无障碍：读屏开启时弹窗改为系统确认框、结果自动朗读、触控区放大到 48dp
- Accessibility: system dialogs, spoken results and 48dp touch targets when a screen reader is on.

- 安装包约 1.5 MB，覆盖安装不丢数据
- About 1.5 MB, installs over the old version without losing data.
